title: Explain a Hypothetical Choice

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Prepare briefly and record your own response of 120–160 words. The sample is shorter than the 90–120 second target. Add relevant details and allow natural pauses while staying within 120–160 words.
prompt: Speak for about 90–120 seconds, using 120–160 words. Describe a fictional person considering a rescue animal, explain a temporary or permanent option and give one hypothetical suggestion. Use at least six lesson words.
reference: My fictional friend is interested in an animal companion from a rescue group. She likes a friendly adult cat, but she has not decided whether a permanent home would be suitable. She could ask the staff about a temporary foster stay and describe her work schedule. If she had a free afternoon, she would visit again before making a promise. I would ask about the cat's temperament and what the first meeting involves. A gentle visit may be useful, but trust takes patience, and a single meeting does not tell us everything. My friend also likes a puppy with a blanket and a toy, yet she knows affection alone is not a complete plan. If I were her, I would write down my questions and speak with the people responsible for the animals.
